blocking: On mobile, the motion control disappears below the hero while indefinitely animated leaves remain active farther down the page.
The mobile side tab occupies about 34px, but ordinary content reserves only a 20px gutter; it can obscure text and controls when it reappears.

fixes.what: Keep the pause control available throughout the page wherever continuous animation remains. Use the stable accessible label 'Pause motion' with aria-pressed=true meaning paused.
fixes.why: Visitors must be able to stop ongoing motion without returning to the hero; 'Motion, pressed' communicates the current behavior poorly.

fixes.what: Reserve at least 44px on the content's right edge at mobile widths, or place the tab in a dedicated rail outside the reading column.
fixes.why: The tab returns after 700ms of inactivity, precisely when visitors stop scrolling to read.

fixes.what: Close the mobile navigation when crossing the 768px header breakpoint, and close it when focus leaves the header or a navigation link is activated.
fixes.why: The nav-open class currently survives desktop resizing, retaining an absolute dropdown and enlarged vertical links after its toggle disappears.

fixes.what: Apply scroll translation to a leaf wrapper and looping drift to its child; do not animate the same leaf's y property with two independent tweens.
fixes.why: The scrubbed animation and infinite animation currently compete for the same transform component, producing inconsistent motion.

fixes.what: Allow the expanded panel's text to determine its minimum height, with a stacked layout for short viewports. Verify the longest ceremony description at 200% zoom.
fixes.why: A fixed height capped at 640px, substantial padding, and overflow:hidden can clip descriptions as available height or text width decreases.

fixes.what: Gate video loading and playback on hero visibility, and pause on document visibilitychange; resume only when visible and motion is enabled.
fixes.why: Direct inquiry links currently initiate a video download before the observer pauses playback, wasting bandwidth for visitors who never view the hero.
